subject: SIG questionnaire: SilverHarbor — evidence scope & artifact clarifications
messages:
From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@silverharbor.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@silverharbor.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire + initial evidence request

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our completed SIG questionnaire (version attached as SIG_questionnaire_SilverHarbor_v1.xlsx). We've highlighted a few areas where we need evidence or control narratives from Redwood to complete our internal review:

- Key management and rotation proof for customer data keys (backup and on-disk).
- Network segmentation diagrams for private deployments (we're evaluating Dedicated).
- Data retention and deletion workflows for tenant-scoped data.

Can your team provide an expected delivery window and an initial mapping file (control -> artifact) so our InfoSec team can triage? Procurement is copied for scheduling.

Thanks,
Elena Varga
Sr. Information Security Manager
SilverHarbor Bank

Attachment: SIG_questionnaire_SilverHarbor_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@silverharbor.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + initial evidence request

Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear callouts. I've attached a starter crosswalk (redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.csv) that maps our standard SIG controls to the artifacts we can provide. High-level replies below; more detail and owners are cc'd.

- KMS & key rotation: we can provide a snapshot of KMS rotation logs and a signed statement of our rotation policy. See attached kms-rotation-snapshot-20270510.pdf for an anonymized example; full logs require an NDA/process which we can coordinate.
- Network segmentation for Dedicated: Kimberly will own the Dedicated topology and will provide a diagram plus a short narrative about tenant isolation and VPC peering patterns.
- Retention & deletion: Karthik will provide our retention matrix and the automated deletion workflow docs, including sample API calls for deletion.

Proposed timeline:
- May 13: Kimberly delivers Dedicated topology diagram draft
- May 14: Karthik delivers retention/deletion matrix
- May 17: Full completed crosswalk with artifact links and any redactions we need to apply

If that works, I'll set a 30-minute sync with your InfoSec team to walk the crosswalk on May 18.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Strategic Accounts, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.csv (text/csv)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@silverharbor.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + initial evidence request

Hi Elena — Kimberly here (Redwood Dedicated infra lead). Quick notes and what I'll attach by EOD on May 13: 

1) Dedicated topology diagram (attached draft) showing tenant network plane, management plane, and peering patterns. We'll include a legend for ingress controls and a brief note about control-plane isolation.

2) For KMS: the customer-managed-key (CMK) flow differs by deployment. For Hosted API, keys are managed in our KMS and we can produce rotation records. For Dedicated or Private, customers can bring their own keys via KMS/HSM integration — we'll include the integration guide excerpt.

Question for SilverHarbor: do you need evidence of backup encryption for snapshots retained by Redwood (we provide encrypted backups by default), or are you specifically requesting customer-side proof for BYOK scenarios? That affects what logs we prepare.

Draft attachment: dedicated-topology-draft.svg (image/svg+xml)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer — Dedicated
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@silverharbor.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Varga <elena.varga@silverharbor.com>, procurement@silverharbor.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + initial evidence request

Rachel / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications from InfoSec:

- For backups: we need confirmation that backups are encrypted at rest and held under CMKs with rotation history accessible. For Dedicated, we may ask to see a sample rotation event tied to a CMK ARN (anonymized).
- For retention: we only need the logic for tenant-data deletion and a pointer to API calls that trigger deletion; screenshots or request/response examples are fine.

Timeline: we prefer to get the topology diagram and retention/logic docs by May 17 to keep our procurement window open. If you can provide the crosswalk with artifact links on May 17 as proposed, Procurement will move to the next step.

Tom Reynolds
Director, Procurement
SilverHarbor Bank
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@silverharbor.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@silverharbor.com>

Best,
